two lanes, two clocks — daily Form-4 flow vs the SEC bulk role panel — side by side only, never blended两条通道、两个时钟——每日Form-4资金流与SEC批量角色面板——仅并列展示，绝不混合
Descriptive flow, not a signal. Open-market trades only (P/S transaction codes) — grants and awards are excluded. The Form-4 lane is daily; the SEC role panel lags ~45 days. Each board carries its own clock; nothing is combined across lanes.描述性资金流，并非信号。仅含公开市场交易（P/S交易代码）——不含授予与奖励。Form-4通道为日频；SEC角色面板滞后约45天。每个榜单带各自时钟；不同通道的数据绝不合并。
